steps.title: Set up
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&A=\text{ even numbers }2\text{ to }20,B=\text{ odd}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{numbers }1\text{ to }19,\text{ so }A\cup B=U\text{ and }A\cap \\[5pt]&\quad \text{B = $\phi$}\\[5pt]&A'=U-A=\{1,3,5,\ldots ,19\}=B\\[5pt]&B'=U-B=\{2,4,6,\ldots ,20\}=A\\[5pt]&\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{First law: (A }\mathbf{\cup B)'=A'\cap B'}}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(A $\cup$ B)$'$ = U$'$ = $\phi$ $\ldots$ (i)}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{A$'$ $\cap$ B$'$ = B $\cap$ A = $\phi$ $\ldots$ (ii)}\end{aligned}\]

steps.title: Result
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\quad \text{From (i) and (ii): (A }\cup B)'=A'\cap B'\\[5pt]&\quad \text{$\;\checkmark$}\\[5pt]&\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{Second law: (A }\mathbf{\cap B)'=A'\cup B'}}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(A $\cap$ B)$'$ = $\phi$$'$ = U = \{1, 2, 3, $\ldots$, 20\} $\ldots$}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(iii)}\\[5pt]&\quad A'\cup B'=B\cup A=\{1,2,3,\ldots ,20\}=U\\[5pt]&\quad \ldots \text{ (iv)}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{From (iii) and (iv): (A }\cap B)'=A'\cup \\[5pt]&\quad B'\text{ $\;\checkmark$}\end{aligned}\]
